8:
The tutorial can be viewed anytime from
Help on the menu screen.
10:
Touch the character on screen, or slide
over them repeatedly, to get all sorts of
reactions.
11:
Characters react differently to a touch
than to repeated sliding, so try out lots of
things.
12:
You can scroll the screen with the X and B
Buttons or Up and Down on the +Control
Pad.
13:
Scrolling lets you check out the
character's whole body.
15:
When your touch gets a reaction your
partner likes, the Feeling Gauge at the top
of the screen goes up.
16:
Raise the Feeling Gauge to MAX and the
Finish Mark will appear.
17:
Touch the Finish Mark to clear
Communication Mode.
18:
On the other hand, if they start to dislike
you, the Feeling Gauge goes down.
19: If the Feeling Gauge hits 0, it's Game Over.
20:
Whatever you do, keep your mind on raising
the Feeling Gauge.
21:
Spots that get you disliked when touched
will often get a happy reaction when slid
instead...
22:
...so using touch and slide in the right
places is especially important.
24:
During Communication Mode, a gauge with a
clock on it is shown on the bottom screen.
26:
Time runs down as the clock ticks, and if
you don't clear before it hits 0, it's Game
Over.
27:
Keep an eye on your remaining Time and the
Feeling Gauge.
29:
When you clear Communication Mode, your
grade is shown on the Results screen.
30:
Grades are rated on five levels.
(Low <-) D, C, B, A, S (-> High)
31:
Clearing with a good grade gives you a
bonus to the Growth Points you earn.
32:
Clearing quickly earns a good grade, so do
your best and aim for a high rank.
34:
Depending on the situation, you may need
to hold the DS a different way.
35:
When that happens, a notice screen will
appear as you enter Communication Mode.
37:
During Communication in the story, after
two Game Overs you'll get the option to
skip.
38:
If you just can't clear a Communication no
matter what, go ahead and use it.
39:
However, in that case you won't earn any
Growth Points.
41: Please choose an explanation to view.
43:
As you strengthen Tomoki's parameters,
touching may sometimes trigger a Special
Reaction.
44:
During a Special Reaction, the message
window turns red.
45:
During a Special Reaction, the Feeling
Gauge rises more than usual.
46:
The higher you raise your parameters, the
more easily Special Reactions occur, so
help Tomoki grow actively!
48:
If you keep touching the same spot over
and over, the character will start to
dislike you and the Feeling Gauge will drop.
49:
To judge whether the character will be
pleased or annoyed, it's a good idea to
refer to the Danger Signal.
50:
Blue light: There are almost no spots that
will make the character dislike you when
touched.
51:
Yellow light: A few spots that will make the
character dislike you when touched are
starting to appear.
52:
Red light: Touching most spots will make the
character dislike you.
53: The danger level recovers as time passes.
54:
Also, just because the Signal is red
doesn't mean touching will always make the
character dislike you.
55:
Be bold at times and careful at others as
you make your moves.
56:
However, touching a spot the character
hates will make them dislike you no matter
what, so be careful.
58:
During play, a character may get angry and
attack you, or some other trouble may
occur.
59:
These unexpected situations are
collectively called Happening Time.
60:
During Happening Time, the screen display
switches like this.
61:
A gauge showing the time remaining in
Happening Time appears at the top of the
lower screen.
62:
Multiple Touch Markers and Scratch
Markers will appear, so deal with them
appropriately.
63:
Touch Markers are cleared by touching
them, and Scratch Markers by sliding over
them continuously.
64:
The number next to each marker shows its
durability.
65:
If you can clear every marker before time
runs out, you've successfully handled
Happening Time.
66:
If you fail, your remaining time gets cut, so
do your best to succeed.
